summary: Frontend-only mobile preview testing: dashboard loads in Indonesian; expense item search/save and monthly report category breakdown pass. Buyer search and sale, flock/production, and reload persistence could not be fully completed because preview sessions reset AsyncStorage and the created buyer was unavailable in the next session.

integration_issues.issue: Buyer created in one preview session was not available in the next session; this prevents confirming buyer search and buyer history end-to-end in the public preview.

action_items: Retest buyer CRUD/history and sale buyer search in a single uninterrupted session with AsyncStorage retained.
Add testID attributes to all primary navigation, FAB, quick-action, tab, and buyer/item option controls for reliable mobile automation.
critical_code_review_comments: Most interactive Pressable controls have no testID, making robust automated verification difficult; only form inputs and save buttons expose test IDs.
Expo log contains a React Native DevTools electron sandbox warning, but Metro and web bundling complete successfully.
seed_data_creation: Created local Jagung expense (Pakan, 5 kg, Rp 25.000) during the isolated preview session.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Live URL https://telur-kampung.preview.emergentagent.com tested at 375x667. Dashboard and expense/report flow passed. Public preview reset local records between browser sessions, so create buyer and sale in the same run before checking buyer search, fixed total, history, and reload persistence.
rca_of_issue: The unavailable buyer could be caused by preview-session AsyncStorage isolation/reset rather than a confirmed application persistence defect. Prior iteration also reported expense failure, but this iteration reproduced expense save successfully; retest in one session is required before assigning RCA. No APIs are mocked.
